_meta.description: Line 7A's stations in order from Airport Colony to CSIA, as MMRDA's Line 9 and 7A page lists them. 'kml_name' is the station's point in MMRDA's alignment file. Positions and along_m come from scripts/build-alignment-line7a.py. Names follow MMRDA's English list; name_mr its Marathi page.

location.method: MMRDA alignment file for Line 7A (KMZ on the Metro Influence Zone page, uploaded March 2025): point "AIRPORT COLONY". along_m is measured along the centre line between the file's two tracks, from Airport Colony station; the point is 6 m from that line.

context.text: On the Western Express Highway in Vile Parle (E), the first station after Gundavali, where 7A leaves Line 7.
The height the airport allows here is below the design for the overhead wire; part of the stretch may have to be rebuilt (reported, Aug 2026).

construction_status.notes: MMRDA, 31 Aug 2026: elevated station items 100% except T and L girder erection (74%). Civil package CA-48 (J Kumar Infraprojects).

location.method: MMRDA alignment file for Line 7A (KMZ on the Metro Influence Zone page, uploaded March 2025): point "CSIA (International) Station". along_m is measured along the centre line between the file's two tracks, from Airport Colony station; the point is 29 m from that line.

interchanges.notes: The Metro Rail Guy (Jul 2025): the Terminal 2 station is where 7A meets Line 3 (Aqua Line), at Line 3's CSMIA T2 station. MMRDA does not name it.

context.text: Underground at the airport's Terminal 2 (Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport). MMRDA's alignment file calls it 'CSIA (International) Station'.

construction_status.notes: MMRDA, 31 Aug 2026: excavation 98%, base slab 83%, concourse slab 65%, roof slab 64%. Civil package CA-48 (J Kumar Infraprojects).
